name: Marrow-Gnawer
description: A nezumi who joins the hyozan; Toshi ends his suffering with an axe.

description_citations.text: "Toshiro Umezawa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Marrow-Gnawer unites three nezumi gangs by slaying their leaders in one night.
timeline.quote: Marrow-Gnawer united three nezumi gangs when he slew their leaders in a single night.

citation.text: Marrow-Gnawer (Champions of Kamigawa, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Marrow-Gnawer orders the guard tripled against the Okiba Gang.

citation.text: Nezumi Shadow-Watcher (Betrayers of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Toshi finds Kiku, sole survivor of her clan, helps control her shadow powers, and recruits Marrow-Gnawer.
timeline.quote: He finds Kiku as the sole survivor of her wizarding clan.

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu reveals the oath kills any who kill without drawing blood and chokes Kiku and Toshi; Marrow-Gnawer stabs Hidetsugu in the eyes, bringing the oath's wrath on himself.
timeline.quote: he saves Toshi and Kiku by stabbing Hidetsugu in the eyes

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: O-Kagachi appears; the Oni of Chaos flees, breaking Hidetsugu's spirit, and Toshi mercy kills Marrow-Gnawer.

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi goes to the Heart of Frost, gains the Yuki-Onna's frost power and captures her in a magic disk, forcing Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer into the Hyozan Reckoners.
timeline.quote: then succeeds in gaining the Onna's power of frost and capturing her in a magic disk via a kanji ritual.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu nearly kills Toshi and Kiku; Marrow-Gnawer stabs his eye and Toshi stabs the other.
timeline.quote: Toshi used Hidetsugu's momentary distraction and stabbed his remaining eye.

citation.text: "Hidetsugu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer are forced to join the Hyozan Reckoners after the yuki-onna kill her men.
timeline.quote: Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer were forced to join the Hyozan Reckoners .

citation.text: "Kiku", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Minamo, Hidetsugu defeats Kiku bloodlessly; Marrow-Gnawer stabs his eye and the tile breaks, so the curse reclaims her.
timeline.quote: In the fall, the tile was broken and the curse claimed her again.

citation.text: "Kiku", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi accidentally interrupts a parley and defeats two soratami; Chiyo's party then waits at his home.
timeline.quote: The moonfolk tried to kill him, but he defeated them with the help of his kanji magic.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Pursuers are killed by the yuki-onna; Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer are forced to join the hyozan; the yuki-onna is imprisoned in a tile.
timeline.quote: The yuki-onna was then imprisoned inside a tile.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer turn on Uramon; Toshi steals the Shadow Gate and is united with it by Night's Reach.
timeline.quote: When Uramon ordered Toshi's death, both of the new hyozan turned on their former lord.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu chokes Toshi and Kiku; Marrow-Gnawer stabs his eye and invokes the oath's wrath.
timeline.quote: Marrow-Gnawer managed to stab the ogre's eye, freeing Toshi and Kiku but invoking the wrath of the oath upon himself.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi ends Marrow-Gnawer's suffering with an axe.
timeline.quote: The ronin was, however, unable to save Marrow-Gnawer from the curse and so ended the nezumi's suffering with an axe.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Mercy killing to end his suffering.
relations.quote: so ended the nezumi's suffering with an axe.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
